ops.title: Use ordered native call lookup for signal projections
ops.description: Owner /root/ccx_related_topk_ship. Source-confirmed signal_texts→signal_event invokes ActivityIndex.call_at once per tool block, while call_at linearly searches all calls of that turn. A long turn therefore performs quadratic metadata comparisons. Cached calls are already monotonically ordered by(event,block ordinal). Next executable step: freeze bounded binary-search replacement and real signal_texts32/4096 operation-count plus legacy-output oracle, identical unmodified-source diagnostic, independent review, CI-only checks. No host-pressure attribution from source alone. Evidence source SDK20 6f81 snapshot_projection.rs1222 and snapshot_activity.rs336.
